[{"insert":"DB Cross Body Hammer Curl + DB Skullcrusher

Two arm isolation movements paired to finish the session with a bicep and tricep pump. The cross body hammer curl pulls the dumbbell across the body, which emphasizes the brachialis and brachioradialis alongside the bicep. The dumbbell skullcrusher loads the triceps at the stretched position overhead. Push close to failure on each set with minimal rest between movements.
"}]
